current.text: Signed a four-year, 64 million USD contract with Milwaukee this offseason.
Experts call the contract horrific. Milwaukee is full of guards, and it is unclear where he fits.
Milwaukee's backcourt is crowded with Herro, Rollins, Porter, Jakucionis, Burries, Green and Trent. He is not in the projected starting five of Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
He may get minutes so the team can justify his contract.
New coach Taylor Jenkins might use a deep rotation. The team is expected to focus more on young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes.
Experts expect the Bucks to be bad and to need trades to consolidate a roster overloaded with guards.

durable.text: Gets very few rebounds, even for a guard.
